QUICK SETUP GUIDE
Where everything goes in Discord. Menu names can change a little when Discord updates.
Upload emojis
Server Settings › Emoji › Upload Emoji. You can select many
files at once. The file name becomes the emoji name.
Add role icons
Server Settings › Roles › pick a role › Display › Role Icon ›
Upload Image.
Set the server icon
Server Settings › Server Profile (or Overview) › Icon › Change
Icon. Use a file from 03 Server Icons.
Post headers
Drag a header PNG into a channel and send it above your
text, or add it as the image of an embed with Discohook or
your bot.
Banner & invite background
Server Settings › Server Profile. Server Banner uses the
960×540 files, Invite Background uses the 1920×1080 files.
Use the guides
Open the PDFs in 06 to 09 for the server structure, color
codes, symbols and fonts. Everything on a light box in the
Symbols guide can be copied.
Edit the PSDs
Install the fonts in “Fonts (install first)”, then open the PSD in
Photoshop or Photopea (free). Steps are in HOW TO
EDIT.pdf.

title: HOW TO EDIT
pages:
PSD Templates
Server Essentials Pack · Lite
HOW TO EDIT
LOGOS
Change the text, swap the background and export, in Photoshop or the free Photopea (photopea.com). No
design skills needed.
5 styles
Badge, Gradient, Hexagon, Minimal and Neon. Each folder
has a PSD template and 4 PNG examples.
1024×1024
Server Settings › Server Profile › Icon. Discord crops it into a
circle, keep letters in the middle.
LAYERS IN A LOGO TEMPLATE
Initials (edit me) text + shadow / glow
Ring / Hexagon / Frame / Dot image
Background (replace me) image
1 Install the fonts
Open Fonts (install first), double-click each .ttf file and press Install. Both fonts are free under the SIL Open
Font License.
2 Open the PSD
Photoshop: double-click the file. Photopea: drag the file into the browser tab. If Photoshop asks to update text
layers, click Update.
3 Change the text
Pick the Text tool (T) and double-click the text on the canvas, or double-click the T icon of the layer. Type
your own text.
4 Change the colors
Select the text layer and change the color in the Character panel. For the background, put a new color or
gradient above Background (replace me).
5 Export
Photoshop: File › Export › Export As › PNG. Photopea: File › Export as › PNG. Keep the same size.
Shadows update by themselves. Title shadows are live layer effects (fx). Double-click Drop Shadow under the layer to
change or turn it off.
Best with 1 to 3 letters. Longer text gets too small to read in the server list. The text is centered, so it stays in the middle
when you type fewer or more letters.

title: Community Server Blueprint
pages:
SERVER
BLUEPRINT
A complete, ready-to-copy structure for a community server: categories,
channels, roles, permissions and the settings that keep it safe. Build it in under
30 minutes.
COMMUNITY SERVER
01 Channels & categories
02 Roles & permissions
03 Setup checklist
04 Copy sheet
Server Essentials Pack · Lite Ethical Studio

Server Blueprint
Community Server
01 · CHANNELS & CATEGORIES
Ready-to-copy names for every category, channel and role are on the Copy Sheet at the end of this guide. The " ・ "
between emoji and name is a wide character, so Discord shows a gap on both sides.
⟡  START HERE
Everyone can see this. Read-only for members.
👋‧ welcome TEXT Welcome message + server banner. Read-only.
📜‧ rules TEXT Server rules. Read-only. Link it in onboarding.
📢‧ announcements ANNOUNCE Announcement channel. Only staff can post.
🎭‧ roles TEXT Self-role menus (colors, pings, interests).
❓‧ faq TEXT Common questions so staff do not repeat themselves.
⟡  COMMUNITY
Main chat area for verified members.
💬‧ general TEXT Main chat. Slowmode 3s when the server gets busy.
🖼‧ media TEXT Images, clips and art only. Use threads to reply.
😂‧ memes TEXT Memes and off-topic fun.
💡‧ suggestions FORUM Forum channel. One post per idea, members vote with reactions.
🤖‧ commands TEXT Bot commands only, keeps other channels clean.
⟡  EVENTS
Hidden from New Members until they verify.
🎉‧ events ANNOUNCE Upcoming events. Pair with Discord Events.
🎁‧ giveaways TEXT Giveaways. Members can react, cannot chat.
Server Essentials Pack · Lite Ethical Studio

Server Blueprint
Community Server
01 · CHANNELS & CATEGORIES
(CONT.)
⟡  SUPPORT
Help for members.
🎫‧ tickets TEXT Ticket panel. Members open private tickets here.
🙋‧ help FORUM Forum for public questions, staff marks solved.
⟡  VOICE
Voice channels.
🔊‧ Lounge VOICE Main voice channel.
🎧‧ Chill VOICE Music and quiet hangout.
🎮‧ Gaming VOICE Gaming sessions. User limit optional.
💤‧ AFK VOICE Set as the AFK channel (Server Settings > Overview).
⟡  STAFF
Private. Only staff roles can see this category.
🛡‧ staff-chat TEXT Staff discussion.
📋‧ mod-logs TEXT Moderation and audit logs from your log bot.
📝‧ staff-notes TEXT Rules for staff, warnings list, to-dos.
Set channel permissions on the category, then press "Sync" on each channel. Way faster than editing every channel
one by one.

02 · ROLES & PERMISSIONS
Roles are listed top to bottom in the same order they should be in Server Settings > Roles. "Hoisted" means "Display
role members separately from online members".
ROLE COLOR HOISTED PURPOSE & KEY PERMISSIONS

Administrator

Administrator (give to 1 to 3 people only)

Manage Messages, Timeout Members, Kick Members, Manage
Threads, View Audit Log

Manage Messages in support channels, Timeout Members

Same as Member + Embed Links, Attach Files

Commands

Only what each bot needs. Never Administrator.

Use the matching icons from 02 Role Icons for Owner, Admin, Moderator, Helper, Booster, VIP, Member, New Member,
Bot and Muted.
Server Essentials Pack · Lite Ethical Studio

Server Blueprint
Community Server
03 · SETUP CHECKLIST
Enable Community
Server Settings > Enable Community. Unlocks onboarding, announcement channels, forums and insights.
Verification Level: Medium
Members need a verified email and an account older than 5 minutes. Stops most raid accounts.
Explicit Media Filter
Set to "Filter messages from all members".
Default Notifications: Only @mentions
Server Settings > Overview. New members will not get spammed and leave.
Onboarding
Server Settings > Onboarding. Add #rules, a few questions that give self-roles, and default channels.
AutoMod
Server Settings > AutoMod. Turn on "Block spam", "Block mention spam" and "Commonly flagged words".
@everyone permissions
Remove "Mention @everyone", "Create Invite" (optional) and "Manage" permissions from @everyone.
Role order
Keep the role list in the same order as this blueprint. Bots must sit above the roles they manage.
2FA for moderation
Server Settings > Safety Setup. Require 2FA for moderator actions.
Want blueprints for gaming, study, shop, creator and design servers? They are in the Ultimate edition.

Embeds without a color strip: set the embed color to the embed box color. On the Dark theme that is #242429 (decimal
2368553). The grey box itself is drawn by Discord and cannot be removed.
"Invisible" role dividers like ──  STAFF ── : give the divider role the same color as the profile background of your theme so
the color dot disappears. Never use pure black #000000 as a role color, Discord treats it as "no color". On Onyx use #010101
instead.
One theme at a time: Light, Ash, Dark and Onyx all use different backgrounds, so a color can only be invisible on one of
them. Match the theme most of your members use. Need an exact color for a spot not listed here? Take a screenshot, open
it in a color picker (Photopea, PowerToys, imagecolorpicker.com) and click it.

HOW TO INSTALL
01 Open the font's link and press Get font, then Download all.
02 Unzip the file. Windows: right-click the .ttf files and press Install. Mac: double-click and press Install Font.
03 Restart Photoshop, Photopea or Canva and the font shows up in the font list. In Photopea and Canva most of
these fonts are already built in, so you can just search the name.
Syne and Poppins are already included in the PSD Templates folders, so the headers and banners work right away.
